chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Yaʿqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from some of his companions, from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

The limit of the grave is up to the collarbone. Some of them said: up to the breast. Some of them said: the height of a man, such that the cloth may be extended over the head of the one in the grave. As for the niche-grave (lahd), it should be to the extent that sitting in it is possible.

When death came to ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام, he fell unconscious and remained so for a while. Then the cloth was lifted from him, and he said: Praise belongs to Allah, Who has caused us to inherit Paradise; we may settle therein
wherever we wish; so excellent is the reward of the workers.
Then he said: Dig for me until it reaches the moisture. He said: Then the cloth was spread over him, and he died عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَجْرُ: reward, referring to the recompense of those who act righteously
key_terms.التَّرْقُوَةِ: the collarbone, used as a measure for grave depth
key_terms.الرَّشْحَ: the moisture or dampness reached in the earth while digging
key_terms.اللَّحْدُ: the side niche within the grave prepared for the deceased
key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, mentioned in the Imam’s final words
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave, referring here to its measure and burial dimensions

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the grave’s depth and the final moments of Imam ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith mentions descriptions regarding the depth and form of the grave and the lahd. It also recounts the final moments of Imam ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام, including his recitation of a Qur'anic phrase about inheriting Paradise and his instruction concerning his burial.
